sessionLinks.notes: Opens the local Codex app chat with this thread ID. The ID is the session UUID Codex gives its tools (CODEX_THREAD_ID).

Resumes the session in a Claude Code tab of the VS Code extension. The session must belong to the workspace open in VS Code; otherwise a new conversation starts. A terminal session has no resume link: claude-cli://open only starts a new session.

Opens a chat in the Claude desktop app by its conversation ID. It needs the chat's conversation ID; a tool session ID is not one. Claude Code sessions in the desktop app have no link by ID (claude://code/new only starts a new one).
